historical_review.scope: Read-only verification recorded at the documentation handoff; this is not a current reproduction or a manifest of the public export.

limitations: Checksum agreement detects byte changes; it is not an independent replication or proof of every modeling/measurement choice.
The original environment and data caches were removed after the recorded experiment; recorded cache/environment identities are historical.

public_export.scope: The public export contains selected aggregate evidence and original figures, not all original run artifacts. Its hashes describe only those included files.
